messages.content: 请解释糖化血红蛋白和空腹血糖的区别。空腹血糖代表过去一整天的平均水平吗？

notes: Manual content probe only: HbA1c reflects roughly 2-3 months; fasting glucose is a sampling-time measure after fasting, not an overnight or daily average.

messages.content: 肌酐在本院参考范围内，就能排除肾脏问题吗？用肌酐算出的eGFR和肌酐，是两份完全独立的证据吗？

notes: Manual content probe only: no blanket exclusion; creatinine-derived eGFR depends on creatinine and patient/formula context, not independent confirmation.
